text: As of {date}, the heartbeat completed {value} full tick(s) in the last day.
probe: sql:SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM tick_runs WHERE finished_at >= datetime({now}, '-1 day') AND steps_completed = steps_total

text: As of {date}, {value} predictions have been scored against what happened.
probe: sql:SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM predictions WHERE verdict IS NOT NULL

text: As of {date}, {value} specified capabilities are marked BUILT.
As of {date}, {value} specified capabilities are still PLANNED and not built: {names}.
As of {date}, {value} work items are blocked or open as known risks.
probe: sql:SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM items WHERE status = 'blocked'

text: As of {date}, {value} capability packs are enabled: {names}.
probe: sql:SELECT COUNT(*) AS value, COALESCE(group_concat(substr(key, 6), ', '), 'none') AS names FROM org WHERE key LIKE 'pack:%' AND value = 'enabled'
